    AI Overview
    Mexico Legends and Brazil Legends played a thrilling 2-2 draw on April 19, 2026, at Estadio Banorte (or Estadio Azteca per initial scheduling) in a star-studded exhibition match. Oribe Peralta scored twice for Mexico, while Brazil featured stars like Ronaldinho and Kaká. The match celebrated legendary players and their impact on football history, drawing huge crowds and bringing back iconic figures from both nations. 
    Key Match Highlights - April 19, 2026 
    • Result: Mexico Legends 2-2 Brazil Legends.
    • Star Performers: Oribe Peralta scored twice for Mexico. Brazil's squad featured Ronaldinho, Kaká, and was led by 1970 champion Jairzinho.
    • Venue: The match was highlighted as an iconic return to Mexican soil (often associated with Estadio Azteca, though reports mention Estadio Banorte). 
    Key Players Involved 
    • Mexico Legends: Rafa Márquez, Jared Borgetti, Oswaldo Sánchez, Miguel Layún, Andrés Guardado, and Cuauhtémoc Blanco.
    • Brazil Legends: Ronaldinho, Kaká, Adriano, Gilberto Silva, and Jairzinho. 
    Related Legends Activity 
    • Mexico Legends vs. FIFA Legends (Jan 2026): Mexico Legends played a 5-5 draw against FIFA World Legends (including Xavi, Del Piero, Cafu), winning 3-2 on penalties.
